name: properties
summary: The public properties of an object or of a class defined by a classdef file.
doc: `p = properties(obj)` gives the names of the properties code outside the class can read, as a column cell array of char vectors, in the order the class defines them, its Constant properties last. Without an output it displays them under "Properties for class Name:". Sagebrush supports value classes defined by classdef files (on the path, in @-folders with method files, and in +package folders); handle classes, inheritance, operator overloading, events, enumerations and property validation are not supported yet, and refused when the class loads.

examples.expected:
Properties for class Pt:

    x
    y

differs: Objects of value classes only (classdef files): handle classes and MATLAB's own classes are not supported yet.

name: methods
summary: The public methods of an object or of a class defined by a classdef file, its constructor included.
doc: `m = methods(obj)` gives the names of the class's public methods, its constructor and its static methods included, sorted, as a column cell array. Without an output it lists them under "Methods for class Name:", the static methods after "Static methods:". Sagebrush supports value classes defined by classdef files (on the path, in @-folders with method files, and in +package folders); handle classes, inheritance, operator overloading, events, enumerations and property validation are not supported yet, and refused when the class loads.

examples.expected:
Methods for class Pt:

Pt     norm1

differs: Objects of value classes only (classdef files).

name: isobject
summary: Whether a value is an object of a class defined by a classdef file.
doc: True for an object of a class a classdef file defines, false for every other value: numbers, text, cells, structs and function handles. Sagebrush supports value classes defined by classdef files (on the path, in @-folders with method files, and in +package folders); handle classes, inheritance, operator overloading, events, enumerations and property validation are not supported yet, and refused when the class loads.
differs: Objects of handle classes and of MATLAB's own classes (graphics objects, containers.Map) are not objects here: isobject is false for them.

name: isprop
summary: Whether an object has a property of that name, whatever its access.
doc: True when the object's class defines the property, public or not, Constant properties included; a method's name is not a property. For an array of objects it is true or false for each element; for a value that is not an object it is false, element by element: `isprop([1 2 3], 'x')` is a 1-by-3 false array. Sagebrush supports value classes defined by classdef files (on the path, in @-folders with method files, and in +package folders); handle classes, inheritance, operator overloading, events, enumerations and property validation are not supported yet, and refused when the class loads.
differs: Objects of handle classes and of MATLAB's own classes are not objects here: isprop is false for them.
